### Model Assessment

<!-- Model Assessment Table -->
```{r, echo = FALSE}
assessment_df <- data.frame(
	"R.Squared" = round(params$R2, 4),
	"RMSE" = round(params$RMSE, 4),
	"Bias" = round(params$bias, 4),
	"AIC" = round(params$AIC, 4), 
	"BIC" = round(params$BIC, 4), 
	"AIC.MLL" = round(params$AIC_MLL, 4),
	"BIC.MLL" = round(params$BIC_MLL, 4), 
	"AW" = round(params$AW, 4), 
	"POC" = round(params$POC, 4),
	"CWI" = round(params$CWI, 4)
)

# Transpose dataframe and create a table
assessment_df <- data.frame(t(assessment_df))

knitr::kable(
	assessment_df,
	align = "cccccccccc",
	col.names = c("Statistic", "Values")
)
```

<!-- Model Selection Plot -->
```{r, echo = FALSE}
img_name <- glue("assessment-{params$start}-{params$end}.png")
knitr::include_graphics(file.path(params$img_path, img_name))
```
